ctgov.note: No trials registered on clinicaltrials.gov under China SXT Pharmaceuticals or SXT Pharmaceuticals as lead sponsor

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: China SXT Pharmaceuticals is a Jiangsu-based traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) manufacturer producing TCM pieces (TCMP), advanced TCMP and fine TCMP for the Chinese domestic market. It is a commercial-stage TCM company without a Western-style clinical-trial pipeline of new chemical / biologic entities in P1/P2/P3. As a foreign private issuer it files Form 20-F, not 10-K, and has no trials on clinicaltrials.gov.
